dedupe_keys.name: nepal household waste composition in 58 municipalities 2013 from the adb solid waste management study

description: This dataset gives the percentage composition of household solid waste, such as organic matter, plastics, paper, glass, metals, textiles and other fractions, for each of 58 municipalities in Nepal in 2013. OpenNepal extracted it from the Asian Development Bank report Solid Waste Management in Nepal: Current Status and Policy Recommendations and published it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is the municipalities surveyed for the ADB study at that time. The data are one CSV file, free under the Open Database License. Caveats: it is a single-year snapshot from 2013, the survey methods are those of the ADB study and are not documented on the dataset page, municipal boundaries have since been reorganised, and the publisher is inactive. Simulation uses: parameterising waste generation and composition in collection, recycling and landfill gas models for South Asian towns, and comparing municipal waste streams. Related records: CalRecycle waste characterisation studies (data-calrecycle-waste-characterization) give comparable composition data for California and the UN-Habitat Waste Wise Cities Tool (platform-un-habitat-waste-wise-cities-tool) sets a method for collecting such data.
